author: Haruko
name: BattleMetric
description: Modular Redbot cog for fetching BattleMetrics data, including automatic Server Info panels.
install_msg: BattleMetric loaded. Use [p]help battlemetric to see commands.
end_user_data_statement: Reads the global BattleMetrics API token from Red's shared API-token storage and stores per-guild settings, including Server Info panel channel/message IDs and authorized Discord user IDs.
